entries.reading: A recycle and destroy mod that works
entries.note: Recycling is limited to weapons and apparel. Destruction applies only to items that use HP: a pawn repeatedly performs actual melee attacks against the item where it lies until it is destroyed, through normal attack/damage/destruction behavior. User immediately narrowed everything with HP to items; excludes buildings, plants, living pawns and other non-items. Items without HP are ineligible. No work-timer deletion or direct HP subtraction as an attack substitute. Micro Designations (P2-25) supplies the other item-specific processing options; compose these directly. Detailed recycling refunds and native attack/stack/interruption/reservation/job lifecycle remain for specification. Recycle This and Destroy Item remain research references, not blanket feature-parity selections. Upstream bug diagnosis is not required.

Per-item totals across all linked storages govern automatic refill below X/up to Y, with no category-wide targets; other deliveries may exceed Y. Separately clarified on 2026-11-02: one standard slider applies to all stacks in a storage and defaults to infinite/undefined. It limits only how far haulers refill stacks, never overriding each item's actual applicable stack maximum. A full stack remains full regardless of the slider; finite hauling ceiling is the smaller of the slider and the actual maximum. No per-item slider values, separate enable toggle, stack resizing/splitting or hard cap on non-hauling deliveries. Earlier assistant suggestions of per-item defaults/hard stack caps are superseded. X/Y defaults and remaining source controls require direct analysis/specification. User explicitly instructed the agent to stop asking them to explain existing mod behavior.

User rejected Hunt for Me and explicitly chose custom companions. All of a hunter's qualifying bonded animals with existing Attack + Haul training may accompany them, wandering nearby throughout the hunting job using Pathfinding Lab's herd-wandering update; no separate Hunting training. When the hunter shoots prey and it falls unconscious or dies, only one companion claims that prey, rushes to it, kills it if necessary, then hauls the corpse if a valid destination exists and it can carry it. Exact claimant selection/reassignment, companion radius and failure/lifecycle details remain open; no movement-speed bonus or dog-only restriction selected. Separate interview addition extends directional idle wandering to pen/room animals with provisional 2-3 adjacent steps, no herd-animal center, legal enclosure boundaries, bounded attempts and normal waiting if trapped, including a single-cell room. This is a behavior reference, not a runtime dependency on Pathfinding Lab or selection of its broader pathfinder.
